name: Brent "Doc" Blue
occupation: Teton County coroner (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Teton County coroner (won the November 2022 general election; listed on the official coroner page)
background: Brent "Doc" Blue is the Teton County coroner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. He won the November 2022 general election. The Jackson Hole News&Guide identified him as current county coroner Dr. Brent Blue and reported that he lost the 2026 Democratic primary for county commissioner. Incoming coroner Katrina L. Clauson takes office in January 2027.

sources.name: Jackson Hole News&Guide, Nov. 4, 2026, Dunford, Propst and Chin elected to Teton County Commission
